svg.title: 03 · Constant gentle life: the background over a day
svg.text: 03 · Constant gentle life: the background over a day
The same Main hall in Demo night at three times. The hero's text never sits on the moving layer without its box.

g.text: Doors open at 12:00 · Breakfast in the lounge until 11:00

svg.text: Cool and light: a slow drift, no game art. Calm, as the hype is quiet.

g.text: Quiz now in the lounge · The final starts at 22:15 on the main stage

svg.text: The game's art over the look, glows breathe, particles rise. Lively: the hype builds.
Deep and dim: a very slow drift, no art. Quiet hours cap the level at calm.
Reduced motion or 'none': the looks still change, drawn still; no drift, no particles.
The look cycle (D10): among the looks the organiser chose, at random, a long crossfade every few minutes
The organiser picks the looks in the Theme studio (#784 draws the controls; this issue builds the stage). By default all four; one look means no cycle.
Scrim: the boxes keep their contrast
The game's art, while the hype builds or is live
The hype: how bright and busy the look is
One hour of the Main hall, 20:00 to 21:00: each look holds 3–6 min at random, then a 40 s crossfade; never the same look twice in a row
The order comes from the zone and the day on the server clock: every screen of a zone shows the same look, and a reload picks up where it was. The cycle's pace never changes with the hype.
An own picture, video or the game's art as the backdrop (#784) holds still, with no cycle. At 'none' and under reduced motion the looks still change by a fade, drawn still, without particles.
Every look, the particles too, draws behind the boxes and the header, never over them (as in #784's pack). The morning tint is cool, as here; #784's preview follows this plan.
